title: Pirate Camp
shortDescription: A camp of tarps, tins, and one captain who will not give the boats back.
longDescription:
Tarps over willow poles. Tins with the kitchens' turnip still on them. No blood, no trophies, just other people's work kept in a pile. If the river captain is here, the coat is buttoned and the mooring is treated like a school he did not earn.
North is the slip. East is the cargo hollow. West is the heron post.

fixtures.name: Turnip Tins
fixtures.lookDescription: Tins stamped with a turnip. Examine them.
fixtures.examineDescription: The stamp is the kitchens' mark. These tins were for the refectory. The camp kept them because a locked store was harder than a night boat. Bring them home after the captain is done, or tell Marram and let the landing do the carrying.
